summary: Builds the composite display string for an FTIM timer overlay entry for one vehicle. Fetches the vehicle pointer from dword_7C54F0 by index a2, formats the lap count and total/current lap pair with session-type awareness, copies the driver/vehicle name strings, selects an outline color string (red/green/grey) from a sub_42BDD0 state, and concatenates up to six 48-byte component buffers into the output buffer a3 separated by the path delimiter word_5C692C, skipping components that fail the this[0x17C] filter. Returns 1.

operations.description: Clear the outline output buffer a4 to an empty string at entry.
Load the vehicle pointer for index a2 from the vehicle pointer array dword_7C54F0.
Format the lap number (vehicle + 16480) as decimal into component buffer v17 via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck.
Copy the first 47 characters of the vehicle name string (vehicle + 17952) into component buffer v18 via sub_587DD0 and null-terminate it.
Copy the first 47 characters of the second name string (vehicle + 18104) into component buffer v19 via sub_587DD0 and null-terminate it.
Branch on session type dword_7C56A4 being 5 or 7 to choose the lap fraction format (%d/%s) versus plain lap format (%d).
Format the total race laps dword_8ACF8C into v16; when the sentinel 0x7FFFFFFF is present, use the asc_5C6A78 placeholder string instead of a number.
Clamp the current lap (vehicle + 16444) to at least 0 and, when it exceeds the total and dword_7CE814 is clear, to the total lap count.
Format the current/total lap pair as "%d/%s" into component buffer v20 via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck.
In the non-fraction branch, format the non-negative clamped current lap as "%d" into component buffer v20.
Derive an outline-state selector from sub_42BDD0(a2, v21) minus 1 and strcpy the matching outline color string (aFtim14redoutli, aFtim14greenout, or aFtim14greyoutl) into the output buffer a4.
Copy a 47-character slice into component buffer v22 via sub_46B830 and null-terminate it.
Concatenate the six 48-byte component buffers (v17, v18, v19, v20, v21, v22) into the output buffer a3, inserting the path delimiter word_5C692C between consecutive included components.
Filter components: when this[0x17C] equals 1, only component indices 0, 1, and 4 are appended; otherwise all six components are appended.
